body:
## Context
- Issue #610: `readResumeAuth` in `packages/context-handoff/lib/resume-auth.mjs` reads `.adlc/handoffs/<session_id>.resume-auth.json` via `readJsonFile` (`existsSync` + `readFileSync`), which follows symlinks, can block on a FIFO, and lacks a size cap, whereas `readBypassGrant` in `packages/context-handoff/lib/bypass-grant.mjs` uses `openSync(path, O_RDONLY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_NONBLOCK)` + `fstatSync` + `MAX_BYPASS_GRANT_BYTES`.
- Issue #612: In `packages/context-handoff/lib/adapter.mjs`, `bypassActive` requires `reasons.length === 0` before claiming a verified bypass grant, and `incomplete_scan_lower_bound` (a telemetry-quality lower-bound restriction when a truncated transcript scan reports `depth < HANDOFF_DEPTH`) is pushed before it. Consequently, a verified bypass grant can never clear `incomplete_scan_lower_bound`, and when a verified grant is withheld because a non-bypassable pre-claim reason (`path_protected*`) is present, no diagnostic reason tells the operator that the valid grant was withheld.

## Scope
- `packages/context-handoff/lib/resume-auth.mjs`
- `packages/context-handoff/lib/adapter.mjs`
- `packages/context-handoff/cli-test/cli-unit-lock-auth.test.mjs`
- `packages/context-handoff/adapter-test/adapter-core.test.mjs`

## Changes Required
1. In `packages/context-handoff/lib/resume-auth.mjs`: export `MAX_RESUME_AUTH_BYTES = 4096` and harden `readResumeAuth` to open the file once with `O_RDONLY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_NONBLOCK`, verify `fstat(fd).isFile()` and `stat.size <= MAX_RESUME_AUTH_BYTES`, read and parse JSON from the fd (or via injected `{ fs }` when provided by unit tests), close the fd in `finally`, and check `doc.schema === SCHEMA`.
2. In `packages/context-handoff/lib/adapter.mjs`: allow a claimed verified bypass grant (`bypassActive`) to clear `incomplete_scan_lower_bound` when no non-bypassable pre-claim reason (`path_protected*`) is present, and emit `bypass_grant_withheld:non_bypassable_reason` when `bypassVerified` is true but the grant is withheld due to non-bypassable pre-claim reasons.
3. Add unit tests in `packages/context-handoff/cli-test/cli-unit-lock-auth.test.mjs` and `packages/context-handoff/adapter-test/adapter-core.test.mjs` covering symlink refusal, non-regular file refusal, size-cap refusal, schema mismatch refusal, clearing `incomplete_scan_lower_bound` with a verified bypass grant, and emitting `bypass_grant_withheld:non_bypassable_reason` when a verified grant is withheld.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `readResumeAuth` refuses symlinks, non-regular files, oversized files (> `MAX_RESUME_AUTH_BYTES`), and wrong-schema documents.
- A verified bypass grant clears `incomplete_scan_lower_bound` and reports `bypass_grant_withheld:non_bypassable_reason` when withheld due to protected-path reasons.
- Verify: `node --test packages/context-handoff/cli-test/cli-unit-lock-auth.test.mjs packages/context-handoff/adapter-test/adapter-core.test.mjs`
title: context-handoff: harden readResumeAuth with fd-based O_NOFOLLOW/O_NONBLOCK/size-cap and surface bypass_grant_withheld (#610, #612)
